idle:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: animation sprite atlas for a 2x2-tile (64x64 logical pixels) Space Station 13 xenomorph brood core. EDIT TARGET is the selected concept #8, the low segmented black chitin abdomen with two plum/olive biomass sacs and a forward-facing dark egg-expulsion mouth. Preserve its exact silhouette, anatomical layout, top-down three-quarter angle, dark native xenomorph palette and identity. Keep dark blue-gray chitin with thin hard cool-gray highlights, restrained dark plum membranes and muted olive nutrient sacs. Redraw as clean readable 64x64-style hand pixel art, no glossy gradients/no dense noise; enlarged pixels are fine.
OUTPUT LAYOUT: exactly EIGHT animation frames in a uniform FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS contact atlas, no text/labels/frame borders. Each cell has IDENTICAL dimensions and the SAME sprite center, scale, floor baseline and static rigid chitin shell/roots. Genuine transparent background in every cell. The outer shell and feet MUST be positionally IDENTICAL across frames, movement belongs to soft sacs and mouth shutters only; animate small meaningful deformations rather than scaling or bouncing the whole object. Do not draw floor, smoke, people, creatures, machinery or other structures. Avoid detached duplicate eggs outside the sprite. Make a seamless calm IDLE cycle: frame 1 relaxed sacs, dark empty mouth; 2 gentle inhalation; 3 sacs slightly swollen and mouth membrane flexes; 4 held breath; 5 gentle exhalation and shutters narrow; 6 sacs soften; 7 a small ripple in the mouth membrane; 8 returns to frame 1. Small one-native-pixel breathing, controlled movement, no egg in any idle frame. Keep upper armor, static roots and outer contour locked. The huge lower black mouth must remain obvious.
